title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is a typed page (folio '- 171 -', Exposé 'IX') of Grothendieck's SGA 7 I, Exposé IX 'Modèles de Néron et monodromie', §13. It sits between handwritten pages on divided-power de Rham complexes, so it was probably misfiled in cote 136 or reused as scrap paper (archive stamp 489).

The page finishes a proof from 13.2. Some map F satisfies F(R) ⊂ R' near s because the relevant sections generate R near s.

Corollary 13.2.2 then states a rigidity result. An analytic commutative group A over S satisfying conditions a), b), c) is determined near s, up to unique isomorphism, by its formal completion Â along s, viewed as an Ŝ-group.

§13.3 builds the analytic Raynaud extension, transposing the algebraic construction of §7 to complex analytic geometry. The setting is as follows.
- A is a smooth commutative analytic group over a complex analytic space S with connected fibres.
- E is its Lie algebra, a vector bundle.
- exp : E → A is the exponential, and R = ker(exp) ⊂ E is a discrete, étale-over-S subgroup.
- The fibre R_s at the special point is a free Z-module of finite type, called R_o.

The construction runs in four steps.
1. After shrinking S, the germs of sections of R at s give a homomorphism from the constant analytic group R_{oS} to R ⊂ E (13.3.1).
2. Shrink S further so that any section of O_S with zero germ at s is zero. Since E is locally free, a section of E vanishing near s then vanishes, so the map is injective.
3. Its image R^f, the 'fixed part', is the largest constant subgroup of R, and R_{oS} ≅ R^f induces R^f_s ≅ R_s (13.3.2).
4. The quotient A^♮ = E/R^f (13.3.3) is the analytic Raynaud extension. It gives the uniformization A = A^♮/(R/R^f): over the degeneration, A^♮ is the part of A extended by the 'fixed' periods, and the varying periods R/R^f form the analytic analogue of the Raynaud/Mumford period lattice.

The mathematical role is the analytic counterpart of the Raynaud extension / semi-abelian uniformization of degenerating abelian varieties, used for the monodromy and Néron-model theory of SGA 7.
errors: The corollary is numbered 13.2.2 and refers to 'les conditions a), b), c) de 13.2.2'. That is a self-reference, so the source is probably 13.2.1 or the preceding proposition; it looks like a typo in the typescript.

The shrinking step ('toute section de O_S dont le germe en s est nul soit nul') is asserted without proof. It is valid: since O_{S,s} is Noetherian, one can take a neighbourhood avoiding the embedded components not through s. It is a routine gap rather than an error.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a typed page of the published SGA 7 Exposé IX, misplaced among the 1975-76 manuscript notes on divided-power de Rham complexes. Its content is published and credited; the only curiosity is the archival misfiling or reuse of the sheet.
transcription_corrections: The heading in 13.3 reads 'L'extension de Raynaud analytique'; the word 'Raynaud' is partly overtyped or obscured in the image but is the intended reading.
In (13.3.3) the superscript on A is a hand-drawn natural sign: A^♮ = E/R^f.
The underlined O_S is the structure sheaf (written \underline{O}_S).
